# Saudi Compliance

> SAMA and CMA licensing, MLRO and AML programmes, ongoing compliance and independent review for fintechs in Saudi Arabia. Riyadh office. A ComplyFactor company.

Regulatory compliance advisory in Riyadh for fintechs: incorporation, SAMA and CMA licensing, MLRO and AML programmes, ongoing compliance, independent review. A ComplyFactor company.

## Pages
- [Every stage of the licence path](https://saudicompliance.com/en/services/): Five stages, one firm: incorporation, SAMA and CMA licensing, MLRO and AML programme build, ongoing compliance and independent review for Saudi fintechs.
- [Your MLRO and compliance function](https://saudicompliance.com/en/compliance-function/): Can you outsource your MLRO in Saudi Arabia? SAMA requires Saudi-national CCO and AML Directors. How we recruit, prepare and support them, and build your AML/CFT programme.
- [Compliance that keeps running](https://saudicompliance.com/en/ongoing-compliance/): Co-sourced compliance monitoring, regulatory reporting, SAFIU STR procedures, PDPL compliance and AML training for licensed fintechs in Saudi Arabia.
- [Know where you stand before the regulator does](https://saudicompliance.com/en/audit-review/): Independent AML effectiveness reviews, compliance health checks, regulator inspection support and FATF mutual evaluation readiness for fintechs in Saudi Arabia.
- [Specialists in one market](https://saudicompliance.com/en/about/): Saudi Compliance is a Riyadh-based regulatory compliance advisory for fintechs, and part of ComplyFactor's cross-border AML and licensing practice.
- [CMA licences for fintech and investment firms](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/cma-licences/): CMA licences in Saudi Arabia: the five securities activities, capital in force, 2020 fees, registered persons and the May 2026 draft not yet adopted.
- [CMA FinTech Experimental Permit](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/cma-fintech-experimental-permit/): How the CMA FinTech Experimental Permit works: who can apply, the process, the two-year limit, permit numbers and the April 2026 draft update.
- [Capital market institution licence](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/capital-market-institution-licence/): CMA capital market institution licence in Saudi Arabia: the five activities, capital, Annex 3.1 documents, stages, registered persons and renewal.
- [Crowdfunding licence in Saudi Arabia](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/crowdfunding-licence-saudi-arabia/): CMA crowdfunding licence in Saudi Arabia: equity (2022) and debt (2025) platforms under an Arranging licence, offer limits and client money rules.
- [Robo-advisory licensing in Saudi Arabia](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/robo-advisory-licence/): Robo-advisory in Saudi Arabia has been CMA-regulated since March 2026 and runs under a Managing licence. The conditions, IT Officer, capital and fees.
- [Insurance Authority licensing for insurtechs](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/insurance-authority-licence/): Insurance Authority licensing in Saudi Arabia for insurers, brokers, aggregators and insurtechs: the rules in force, the Insurance Lab and the draft law.
- [PDPL compliance for fintechs](https://saudicompliance.com/en/pdpl-compliance-saudi-arabia/): PDPL compliance for Saudi fintechs: SDAIA, controller registration on the data governance platform, transfers, 72-hour breach notice and the 2026 draft.
- [Cybersecurity rules your licence file must answer](https://saudicompliance.com/en/cybersecurity-compliance-saudi-arabia/): Cybersecurity compliance for Saudi fintechs: NCA Essential and Cloud Cybersecurity Controls, CST cloud rules, SAMA's framework and your licence file.
- [Set up the entity your licence needs](https://saudicompliance.com/en/incorporation/): Setting up a fintech company in Saudi Arabia: MISA investment registration, the 2025 Commercial Register Law, ZATCA and Fatoora, GOSI and Nitaqat.
- [Crypto in Saudi Arabia: the straight answer](https://saudicompliance.com/en/digital-assets/): Crypto regulation in Saudi Arabia, October 2026: no VASP licence or crypto rulebook, FATF lists KSA as prohibiting VASPs, and the routes firms use instead.
- [Every fintech licence in Saudi Arabia, mapped](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/): Every SAMA and CMA fintech licence in Saudi Arabia in one table: capital, fees, 2026 status, SAMA's 90-day decision period and the application steps.
- [SAMA payment institution licence](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/payment-institution-licence/): SAMA payment institution licence: Micro PI needs SAR 1m capital, Major PI SAR 3m. Fees, legal form, safeguarding, the 90-day decision and senior roles.
- [E-money institution licence](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/e-money-licence/): SAMA e-money licence for wallets: Micro EMI SAR 2m and Major EMI SAR 10m capital, per-user limits, safeguarding, JSC form and the 90-day decision.
- [Buy now, pay later licence](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/bnpl-licence/): SAMA BNPL licence: SAR 5m capital, joint stock company, SAR 10,000 per-consumer limit since Dec 2025, 12 instalments, 50% Saudization and 60-day approval.
- [Open banking licence](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/open-banking-licence/): SAMA began open banking licensing on 26 March 2026 under the payments rules: payment initiation needs SAR 1m capital, account information SAR 0.5m.
- [Finance company licence](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/finance-company-licence/): SAMA finance company licence: capital from SAR 5m to SAR 200m by activity under the 2025 regulation, 50% Saudization rising to 75%, fees and approval.
- [Finance aggregation licence](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/finance-aggregation-licence/): SAMA finance aggregation (digital intermediation) licence for loan marketplaces: SAR 2m capital, three-year term, 50% Saudization, 30-working-day decision.
- [SAMA regulatory sandbox](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/sama-regulatory-sandbox/): SAMA regulatory sandbox: who can apply, the 60-day, 120-day and 6 to 12 month stages, the waivers SAMA can grant and the route to a full licence.
- [Digital bank licence](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/digital-bank-licence/): SAMA digital-only bank licence: a locally incorporated joint stock company, capital set case by case (EZ Bank: SAR 2.5bn), Cabinet approval and the steps.
- [Money exchange licence](https://saudicompliance.com/en/licensing/money-exchange-licence/): SAMA money exchange licence: SAR 2m capital for currency dealing, SAR 7m with cash import and export, fees, legal forms and no new money-transfer licences.

## Guides
- [Outsourced MLRO in Saudi Arabia: What SAMA and CMA Allow](https://saudicompliance.com/en/insights/outsource-mlro-saudi-arabia/): Outsourced MLRO in Saudi Arabia: SAMA firms need a Saudi-national Director of AML/CTF; some CMA firms may delegate the MLRO. What you can buy in instead.
- [Real Estate Tokenization in Saudi Arabia: 2026 Status Guide](https://saudicompliance.com/en/insights/real-estate-tokenization-saudi-arabia/): Real estate tokenization in Saudi Arabia in October 2026: REGA runs a sandbox, pilots are complete and no national tokenization law is confirmed.
- [Saudi AML Law Amendments 2026: What Changed and What to Do](https://saudicompliance.com/en/insights/saudi-aml-law-2026-amendments/): Saudi AML law amendments 2026: Royal Decree M/223 changed the AML Law in April and revised rules were published in June. What firms should update now.
- [Saudi Arabia Financial Regulators: Who Licenses What (2026)](https://saudicompliance.com/en/insights/saudi-financial-regulators-guide/): Saudi Arabia financial regulators explained: SAMA licenses payments, lending and banks, the CMA securities, the IA insurance. No crypto licence exists.
- [Saudi Fintech Events 2025-26: What Changed for Licensing](https://saudicompliance.com/en/insights/saudi-fintech-events-2025-2026/): Saudi fintech events 2025-26: SAMA moved open banking to commercial licensing, REGA oversaw the first deed tokenization and CMA opened the Main Market.
